method.method_draft: First describe the image: the core is a C-N framework with substituents R1 and R2 on the central carbon, R3 and R4 on nitrogen, an HO group attached to the central carbon, plus curved arrows and an H+/charge annotation. Build the non-hydrogen connectivity graph. At the central carbon, count four non-H connections: to R1, R2, O, and N. At nitrogen, add only its two additional non-H substituent connections, N-R3 and N-R4, because C-N was already counted. Do not add O-H or the standalone H/charge, and do not count arrows. Sum 4 + 2 = 6.
